    "Read-only independent review of scoped implementation, requirements, tests and retained evidence. No application source was changed, no builds/tests or endpoints were launched, and no credentials were accessed.     "Independently recomputed all four supplied fingerprints and verified 528 source-inventory entries, 272 referenced artifacts, run input/log/artifact hashes, mutation input hashes and the passing C14 attempt-06 predecessor receipt chain.",
    "Attempt-03 R2 is resolved. Planning checks the captured jar Cookie against the request's own credential sources before auth-secret resolution or dispatch. Every authentication variant counts as a source regardless of its generated header name.     "Earlier remediations remain intact: registered-origin classification independent of credential source, generated/literal override refusals, destination admission before managed-secret resolution, permanent context retirement, single-use confirmed reviews, full authentication/secret-generation/cookie bindings, captured first-hop cookies, credential redaction and explicit retry without replay.     "Retained logs report 344 frontend tests, 146 Rust library tests, 16 HTTP integration tests and 5 focused React Send tests passing. The managed-redirect probe remains caught at its unregistered loopback target.",
    "All nine required C15 native checks are recorded as passing on executable 626bd23b5fd79a44e44e20b72f8941a8aff9de3c91262367efa579e5c2299f50, matching the independently hashed prepared executable and workload record.     "Verified the registered workload table hash and recomputed nearest-rank p95 values: response 484.03 ms, upload 93.11 ms, save 485.71 ms and responsiveness 38.57 ms; maximum process-tree RSS is 330.4 MiB. All meet the registered limits and sample counts. Recorded response/save sizes and responsiveness-during-transfer checks agree with the registered workload.",
    "Native and performance evidence uses synthetic loopback services and staged folder/save-sheet paths. Production file-sheet interaction, spoken VoiceOver output, installed signed packages and live product qualification remain outside this review. The 193 catalogue entries remain request specifications. This passing verdict is scoped to C15 and does not constitute cumulative P04 approval."
